review_notes: Source-first scope: Section 2.2.1 says the current-performance/readability relationship is unclear and economically slight, then identifies future performance—especially earnings persistence—as the better setting for testing the management-obfuscation question. The selected principal family is therefore Table 4 Panels A/B, whole-report Fog and Length, positive current-earnings firms, with separate t+1 and t+2 dependent-variable fits. Table 3 current-earnings/readability is excluded as a subordinate current-performance test despite its abstract summary.

Within Table 4, whole-report Fog and whole-report Length are the principal parallel readability proxies. MD&A/Notes-only columns and Panel C’s joint section comparison are excluded as section-level partition/follow-up analyses; Table 5 loss-firm results, Table 3’s change specification and profit/loss replacement, Section 5 lexical features, and later options/return tests are also outside this principal family.

The Table 4 note explicitly lists RET_VOL and its interaction with earnings, so it is retained. Table 3 is excluded under the source-first scope; although its footnote enumeration omits RET_VOL while surrounding text refers back to Table 2 determinants and the note defines RET_VOL, no Table 3 RHS is carried into the selected record.

The supplied reading’s coordinator-verified math transcription resolves OCR corruption in Table 4: Fog uses a multiplier of 0.4, DIV uses Compustat data21>0, and SIZE/MTB use multiplication of data25 and data199. Those exact supplied-source transcriptions are used.

The estimator is not named. Year and industry dummies are included; standard errors are clustered by two-digit SIC industry. The Table 4 note uses signed ACC while Section 4.2 prose says ABSACC, so that source conflict is preserved. The denominator year for earnings scaling and the log bases for NBSEG/NGSEG are not specified.
results_review_notes: Only the four frozen whole-report positive-earnings Table 4 baseline fits and their relevant descriptives are included; section-specific fits, loss samples, Panel C, and later tests are outside scope.
Table 4 note reports significant stars but no exact p-values, degrees of freedom, or sidedness; only printed t-statistics and markers are retained.
The Table 4 note labels ACC as signed accruals while Section 4.2 prose discusses ABSACC; the frozen specifications retain that source ambiguity.

The descriptives summarize current Earnings(t), not the future earnings outcomes at t+1 or t+2; they do not describe any constructed Earnings-by-readability or Earnings-by-control interaction. No missing interaction statistics were calculated from component summaries.

Table 1/2 do not provide direct descriptive rows for the ACC or DIV controls. Table 1 reports market value of equity as a raw version of SIZE and as an input to MTB; table-note transformation definitions are preserved in the variable links.
